units.literal: At the beginning of Wuping he was moved to grand director of ceremonies, given the same ceremonial rank as the three masters, supervised revision of the veritable records, and attended at the Forest of Literary Brilliance.

units.zh: 幼而孝謹，淹雅有器度，好學不倦，美容儀，有風則。
units.en: From childhood he was filial and careful, cultivated and with capacity, tireless in learning, handsome in bearing, with natural dignity.
units.literal: From childhood he was filial and careful, cultivated and with capacity, tireless in learning, handsome in bearing, with natural dignity.

units.zh: 良辰美景，嘯詠遨遊，登臨山水，以談讌為事，人士謂之物外司馬。
units.en: On fine days and fair scenes he would chant and roam, climb hills and waters, making conversation and feasts his affair; gentlemen called him the marshal beyond things.
units.literal: On fine days and fair scenes he would chant and roam, climb hills and waters, making conversation and feasts his affair; gentlemen called him the marshal beyond things.

units.zh: 齊天保初，行太原郡事。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao in Qi he acted as administrator of Taiyuan commandery.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao in Qi he acted as administrator of Taiyuan commandery.

units.zh: 帝臨發，勑王從駕，除晞幷州長史。
units.en: When the emperor set out, he ordered the prince to follow the carriage; Wang Xi was made chief administrator of Bing.
units.literal: When the emperor set out, he ordered the prince to follow the carriage; Xi was made chief administrator of Bing.

units.zh: 歷東徐州刺史、秘書監。
units.en: He passed through posts as governor of eastern Xuzhou and director of the secretariat.
units.literal: He passed through posts as governor of eastern Xuzhou and director of the secretariat.

units.zh: 齊亡，周武以晞為儀同大將軍、太子諫議大夫。
units.en: When Qi fell, Emperor Wu of Zhou made Xi Equal-in-Honor Grand General and grand remonstrant of the crown prince.
units.literal: When Qi fell, Emperor Wu of Zhou made Xi Equal-in-Honor Grand General and Grand Remonstrant of the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 王昕，字元景，北海劇人。
units.en: Wang Xin, styled Yuanjing, was a man of Ju in Beihai commandery.
units.literal: Wang Xin, styled Yuanjing, was a man of Ju in Beihai commandery.

units.zh: 晞無子，帝將賜之妾，使小黃門就宅宣旨，皇後相聞晞妻。
units.en: Wang Xi had no son; the emperor would grant him a concubine; a yellow gate attendant went to his house to announce the edict; the empress also sent word to Wang Xi's wife.
units.literal: Xi had no son; the emperor would grant him a concubine; a yellow gate attendant went to his house to announce the edict; the empress also sent word to Xi's wife.

units.zh: 晞願養母，竟不受署。
units.en: Xi wished to support his mother and in the end did not accept appointment.
units.literal: Xi wished to support his mother and in the end did not accept appointment.

units.zh: 及西魏將獨孤信入洛，署為開府記室。
units.en: When Western Wei general Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he appointed Xi recorder on his opening staff.
units.literal: When Western Wei general Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he appointed Xi recorder on his opening staff.

units.zh: 帝尋發怒，聞晞得杖，以故不殺，髡鉗配甲坊。
units.en: Gao Yang soon flared in anger; hearing Xi had been beaten, on that account he did not kill him but shaved his head, put him in fetters, and assigned him to the armorer's ward.
units.literal: The emperor soon flared in anger; hearing Xi had been beaten, on that account he did not kill him but shaved his head, put him in fetters, and assigned him to the armorer's ward.

units.zh: 乃釋晞令往。
units.en: He released Xi and sent him to the prince.
units.literal: He released Xi and sent him to the prince.

units.zh: 尋有詔以丞相任重，普進府僚一班，晞以司馬領吏部郎中。
units.en: Soon an edict said the chancellor's burden was heavy and all staff advanced one grade; Wang Xi as chief marshal also held the post of gentleman in the ministry of personnel.
units.literal: Soon an edict said the chancellor's burden was heavy and all staff advanced one grade; Xi as chief marshal also held the post of gentleman in the ministry of personnel.

units.zh: 為太子太傅，晞以局司奉璽綬。
units.en: He was made grand tutor of the crown prince; Wang Xi as office-holder received the seal and sash.
units.literal: He was made grand tutor of the crown prince; Xi as office-holder received the seal and sash.

units.zh: 皇太子釋奠，又兼中庶子。
units.en: When the crown prince performed the capping sacrifice, he was also concurrently palace attendant.
units.literal: When the crown prince performed the capping sacrifice, he was also concurrently palace attendant.

units.zh: 帝欲以晞為侍中，苦辭不受。
units.en: The emperor wished to make Wang Xi palace attendant; he firmly declined and would not accept.
units.literal: The emperor wished to make Xi palace attendant; he firmly declined and would not accept.

units.zh: 隋開皇元年，卒於洛陽，年七十一。
units.en: In the first year of Kaihuang under Sui, he died at Luoyang at the age of seventy-one.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaihuang under Sui, he died at Luoyang at the age of seventy-one.

units.zh: 贈儀同三司、曹州刺史。
units.en: He was posthumously granted Equal in Honors to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Caozhou.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted Equal in Honors to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Caozhou.

units.zh: 常詣晉祠，賦詩曰：「日落應歸去，魚鳥見留連。」
units.en: He often visited the Jin shrine and composed a poem: "The sun sets — I ought to go home; fish and birds seem to linger."
units.literal: He often visited the Jin shrine and composed a poem: "The sun sets — I ought to go home; fish and birds seem to linger."

units.zh: 晞由是得免徙，還為王友。
units.en: Xi was thereby spared exile and returned as the prince's companion.
units.literal: Xi was thereby spared exile and returned as the prince's companion.

units.zh: 魏末，隨母兄東適海隅，與邢子良遊處。
units.en: At the end of Wei he followed his mother and elder brothers east to the seacoast and kept company with Xing Ziliang.
units.literal: At the end of Wei he followed his mother and elder brothers east to the seacoast and kept company with Xing Ziliang.

units.zh: 遨遊鞏洛，悅其山水，與范陽盧元明、鉅鹿魏季景結侶同契，往天陵山，浩然有終焉之志。
units.en: Roaming in Gong and Luo, he delighted in the mountains and waters; with Lu Yuanming of Fanyang and Wei Jijing of Julu he formed a bond of like minds and went to Tianling Mountain, with vast resolve to end his days there.
units.literal: Roaming in Gong and Luo, he delighted in the mountains and waters; with Lu Yuanming of Fanyang and Wei Jijing of Julu he formed a bond of like minds and went to Tianling Mountain, with vast resolve to end his days there.

units.zh: 晞稱先被犬傷，困篤不起。
units.en: Xi claimed he had earlier been bitten by a dog and was gravely ill and could not rise.
units.literal: Xi claimed he had earlier been bitten by a dog and was gravely ill and could not rise.

units.zh: 於是方得見寬。
units.en: Only then was he granted leniency.
units.literal: Only then was he granted leniency.

units.zh: 晞曰：「天保享祚，東宮委一胡人，今卒覽萬機，駕馭雄桀。
units.en: Wang Xi said, "In the Tianbao era fortunes held; the eastern palace was entrusted to a barbarian. Now he suddenly oversees all affairs, driving fierce men.
units.literal: Xi said: "In the Tianbao era fortunes held; the eastern palace was entrusted to a barbarian. Now he suddenly oversees all affairs, driving fierce men.

units.zh: 晞曰：「周公抱成王朝諸侯，攝政七年，然後復子明辟，幸有故事，惟殿下慮之。」
units.en: Wang Xi said, "The Duke of Zhou held King Cheng in his arms while receiving the feudal lords at court and served as regent for seven years. He then returned the government to his sovereign. Fortunately, there is a precedent; Your Highness need only consider it."
units.literal: Xi said: "The Duke of Zhou held King Cheng in his arms while receiving the feudal lords at court and served as regent for seven years. He then returned the government to his enlightened sovereign. Fortunately, there is a precedent; Your Highness need only consider it."

units.zh: 晞曰：「殿下將往時地位，猶可以名教出處。
units.en: Wang Xi said, "Your Highness's former standing could still be weighed by name and teaching in going forth and withdrawing.
units.literal: Xi said: "Your Highness's former standing could still be weighed by name and teaching in going forth and withdrawing.

units.zh: 及晉陽陷敗，與同志避周兵東北走。
units.en: When Jinyang fell, he fled northeast with his comrades before the Zhou army.
units.literal: When Jinyang fell in defeat, he fled northeast with comrades to escape Zhou troops.

units.zh: 晞復書曰：「辱告存念，見令起疾，循復眷旨，似疑吾所傷未必是猘。
units.en: Xi wrote back, "I am shamed by your care in asking after me and your order to rise from illness; following and pondering your kind intent, you seem to doubt that my wound may not have been from a mad dog.
units.literal: Xi wrote back: "I am shamed by your care in asking after me and your order to rise from illness; following and pondering your kind intent, you seem to doubt that my wound may not have been from a mad dog.

units.zh: 吾豈願其必猘，但理契無疑耳。
units.en: Would I wish it must have been mad? Only that reason admits no doubt.
units.literal: Would I wish it must have been mad? Only that reason admits no doubt.

units.zh: 就足下疑之，亦有過說。
units.en: As for your doubting it, there is also overstatement.
units.literal: As for your doubting it, there is also overstatement.

units.zh: 足下旣疑其非猘，亦可疑其是猘，其疑半矣。
units.en: Since you doubt it was not mad, you may also doubt it was mad—your doubt is already half.
units.literal: Since you doubt it was not mad, you may also doubt it was mad—your doubt is already half.

units.zh: 若疑其是猘而營護，雖非猘亦無損，疑其非猘而不療，儻是猘則難救。
units.en: If you doubt it was mad and nurse the wound, though it was not mad there is no harm; if you doubt it was not mad and do not treat it, perchance it was mad and then it is hard to save.
units.literal: If you doubt it was mad and nurse the wound, though it was not mad there is no harm; if you doubt it was not mad and do not treat it, perchance it was mad and then it is hard to save.

units.zh: 然則過療則致萬全，過不療或至死。
units.en: Thus overtreatment brings ten thousandfold safety; overt refusal of treatment may bring death.
units.literal: Thus overtreatment brings ten thousandfold safety; overt refusal of treatment may bring death.

units.zh: 奈何奪其萬全，任其或死。
units.en: How can you strip him of ten thousandfold safety and leave him to possible death?
units.literal: How can you strip him of ten thousandfold safety and leave him to possible death?

units.zh: 且將軍威德所被，飈飛霧襲，方掩八竑，豈在一介。
units.en: Moreover the general's prestige and virtue cover all; wind flies and mist strikes, about to enfold the eight reaches—surely not for one man alone.
units.literal: Moreover the general's prestige and virtue cover all; wind flies and mist strikes, about to enfold the eight reaches—surely not for one man alone.

units.zh: 若必從隗始，先須濟其生靈。
units.en: If you must begin from the start, first you must succor the living people.
units.literal: If you must begin from the start, first you must succor the living people.

units.zh: 足下何不從容為將軍言也？」
units.en: Why do you not speak to the general at leisure on my behalf?"
units.literal: Why do you not speak to the general at leisure on my behalf?"

units.zh: 晞流涕曰：「天道神明，豈令殿下遂斃此舍。
units.en: Xi wept and said, "Heaven's way and the spirits—how could they let Your Highness die in this house!
units.literal: Xi wept and said: "Heaven's way and the spirits—how could they let Your Highness die in this house!

units.zh: 至尊親為人兄，尊為人主，安可與校計。
units.en: The Supreme One is elder brother in person and sovereign in rank—how can you contend with him?
units.literal: The Supreme One is elder brother in person and sovereign in rank—how can you contend with him?

units.zh: 殿下不食，太后亦不食，殿下縱不自惜，不惜太后乎？」
units.en: Your Highness will not eat; the empress dowager will not eat either—if Your Highness will not spare yourself, will you not spare the empress dowager?"
units.literal: Your Highness will not eat; the empress dowager will not eat either—if Your Highness will not spare yourself, will you not spare the empress dowager?"

units.zh: 晞言於王曰：「受爵天朝，拜恩私第，自古以為干紀。
units.en: Wang Xi said to the prince, "To receive rank from the heavenly court and pay thanks at a private residence has from antiquity been held a breach of protocol.
units.literal: Xi said to the prince: "To receive rank from the heavenly court and pay thanks at a private residence has from antiquity been held a breach of protocol.

units.zh: 朝廷文武，出入辭謝，宜一約絕。
units.en: Civil and military officials of the court, coming and going with thanks and farewells — it should all be stopped at once.
units.literal: Civil and military officials of the court, coming and going with thanks and farewells — it should all be stopped at once.

units.zh: 主上顒顒，賴殿下扶翼。」
units.en: The sovereign is attentive; he relies on Your Highness to support him."
units.literal: The sovereign is attentive; he relies on Your Highness to support him."

units.zh: 切諫王曰：「今朝廷乃爾，欲學介子匹夫輕一朝之命，狂藥令人不自覺，刀箭豈復識親疏，一旦禍出理外，將奈殿下家業何，奈皇太后何！
units.en: He remonstrated sharply with the prince, "The court is now like this — do you wish to follow some reckless commoner who treats a morning's life lightly? Madness-drug makes a man unaware of himself; blade and arrow no longer know kin from stranger. If disaster suddenly comes from beyond reason, what of Your Highness's household estate — what of the empress dowager!
units.literal: He remonstrated sharply with the prince: "The court is now like this — do you wish to follow some reckless commoner who treats a morning's life lightly? Madness-drug makes a man unaware of himself; blade and arrow no longer know kin from stranger. If disaster suddenly comes from beyond reason, what of Your Highness's household estate — what of the empress dowager!

units.zh: 乞且將順，日慎一日。」
units.en: I beg you for now to yield and go along, and be more careful day by day."
units.literal: I beg you for now to yield and go along, and be more careful day by day."

units.zh: 如聖德幼沖，未堪多難，而使他姓出納詔命，必權有所歸。
units.en: If His Sagehood is young and not equal to many trials, yet others hand in and out the imperial edicts, power is sure to settle somewhere.
units.literal: If His Sagehood is young and not equal to many trials, yet others hand in and out the imperial edicts, power is sure to settle somewhere.

units.zh: 殿下雖欲守藩職，其可得也！
units.en: Though Your Highness wish to keep to princely duty, can you?
units.literal: Though Your Highness wish to keep to princely duty, can you?

units.zh: 遐令得遂沖退，自審保家祚得靈長不？」
units.en: If far-off orders let you retire in modesty, do you yourself judge that the house and throne can endure long?"
units.literal: If far-off orders let you retire in modesty, do you yourself judge that the house and throne can endure long?"

units.zh: 今日事勢，遂關天時，非復人理所及。」
units.en: Today's situation turns on heaven's timing; it is no longer within human reason."
units.literal: Today's situation turns on heaven's timing; it is no longer within human reason."

units.zh: 晞曰：「朝廷比者疏遠親戚，寧思骨血之重。
units.en: Wang Xi said, "The court of late has kept kin at distance — does it consider the weight of bone and blood?
units.literal: Xi said: "The court of late has kept kin at distance — does it consider the weight of bone and blood?

units.zh: 殿下倉卒所行，非復人臣之事，芒刺在背，交戟入頸，上下相疑，何由可久。
units.en: Your Highness's hasty acts are no longer the matter of a minister; a thorn in the back, crossed halberds at the neck — above and below doubting each other; how can it last?
units.literal: Your Highness's hasty acts are no longer the matter of a minister; a thorn in the back, crossed halberds at the neck — above and below doubting each other; how can it last?

units.zh: 且天道不恒，虧盈叠至，神幾變化，肹蚃斯集。
units.en: Moreover heaven's way is not constant; loss and gain pile on; spirit and omen shift — subtle signs gather.
units.literal: Moreover heaven's way is not constant; loss and gain pile on; spirit and omen shift — subtle signs gather.

units.zh: 雖執謙挹，粃糠神器，便是違上玄之意，墜先帝之基。」
units.en: Though you hold modesty and restraint, to treat the sacred vessel like chaff is to go against heaven's intent and wreck the late emperor's foundation."
units.literal: Though you hold modesty and restraint, to treat the sacred vessel like chaff is to go against the Supreme One's intent and wreck the late emperor's foundation."

units.zh: 晞曰：「道路傳言，車駕將行。」
units.en: Wang Xi said, "On the roads they say the imperial carriage will march."
units.literal: Xi said: "On the roads they say the imperial carriage will march."

units.zh: 晞曰：「罪實合死，但恨其不得死地。
units.en: Wang Xi said, "His crime indeed deserves death — only I regret he did not die in the proper place.
units.literal: Xi said: "His crime indeed deserves death — only I regret he did not die in the proper place.

units.zh: 臣聞刑人於市，與衆棄之，殿廷非殺戮之所。」
units.en: I hear that punishing men in the market means abandoning them with the crowd; the palace hall is not a place for killing."
units.literal: I hear that punishing men in the market means abandoning them with the crowd; the palace hall is not a place for killing."

units.zh: 晞遂條十餘事以呈。
units.en: Wang Xi then set out more than ten items and presented them.
units.literal: Xi then set out more than ten items and presented them.

units.zh: 或勸晞勿自疏，晞曰：「我少年以來，閱要人多矣，充詘少時，鮮不敗績。
units.en: Some urged Wang Xi not to distance himself; Wang Xi said, "From youth I have seen many men in power; puffed up for a little while, few did not end in ruin.
units.literal: Some urged Xi not to distance himself; Xi said: "From youth I have seen many men in power; puffed up for a little while, few did not end in ruin.

units.zh: 且性實疏緩，不堪時務，人主恩私，何由可保，萬一披猖，求退無地。
units.en: Moreover my nature is truly loose and slow, unfit for the times; a sovereign's private favor — how can it be kept? If by chance I lose restraint, there is nowhere to seek withdrawal.
units.literal: Moreover my nature is truly loose and slow, unfit for the times; a sovereign's private favor — how can it be kept? If by chance I lose restraint, there is nowhere to seek withdrawal.

units.zh: 非不愛作熱官，但思之爛熟耳。」
units.en: It is not that I do not love the hot office — I have only chewed it over to the end."
units.literal: It is not that I do not love the hot office — I have only chewed it over to the end."

units.zh: 晞陶陶然曰：「我今可謂武有餘文不足矣。」
units.en: Wang Xi said with easy content, "Today I may be called abundant in martial, short in literary."
units.literal: Xi said with easy content: "Today I may be called abundant in martial, short in literary."

units.zh: 每未肯去，行侶尤之，曰：「莫尤我，我行事若不悔，久作三公矣。」
units.en: Again and again he would not hurry on; his companions blamed him. He said, "Do not blame me. Had I not regretted my own ways, I would long since have been one of the Three Excellencies."
units.literal: Time and again he would not consent to leave; his fellow travelers reproached him. He said, "Do not reproach me. Had my conduct been such that I did not regret it, I would long ago have been one of the Three Excellencies."

units.zh: 晞緩笑曰：「昨晚陶然，頗以酒漿被責，卿輩亦是留連之一物，豈直在魚鳥而已。」
units.en: Xi smiled slowly. "Last night I was quite at ease, and got a fair scolding over wine. You lot are detainments too — not fish and birds alone."
units.literal: Xi smiled slowly and said, "Last night I was quite at ease; I was rather reproached for wine. You gentlemen too are among the things that detain one — surely not only fish and birds."

units.zh: 每夜載入，晝則不與語，以晞儒緩，恐不允武將之意。
units.en: Each night he was brought in by carriage; by day they did not speak — because Wang Xi was scholarly and slow, fearing he would not suit the generals' mind.
units.literal: Each night he was brought in by carriage; by day they did not speak — because Xi was scholarly and slow, fearing he would not suit the generals' mind.

units.zh: 武成本忿其儒緩，由是彌嫌之，因奏事大被訶叱，而雅步晏然。
units.en: Emperor Wucheng had long resented his scholarly slowness and therefore disliked him the more; on presenting business he was roundly scolded, yet walked with elegant pace, unruffled.
units.literal: Emperor Wucheng had long resented his scholarly slowness and therefore disliked him the more; on presenting business he was roundly scolded, yet walked with elegant pace, unruffled.

units.zh: 乾明元年八月，昭帝踐祚。
units.en: In the eighth month of the first year of Ganming, Emperor Xiaozhao ascended the throne.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Ganming, Emperor Xiaozhao ascended the throne.

units.zh: 母終後，仍屬遷鄴。
units.en: After his mother died he still went with the move to Ye.
units.literal: After his mother died he still went with the move to Ye.

units.zh: 俄而信返，晞遂歸鄴。
units.en: Soon Dugu Xin returned west; Xi then went back to Ye.
units.literal: Soon Dugu Xin returned west; Xi then went back to Ye.

units.zh: 在幷州，雖戎馬填閭，未嘗以世務為累。
units.en: In Bing Province, though war horses filled the lanes, he never took worldly business as a burden.
units.literal: In Bing Province, though war horses filled the lanes, he never took worldly business as a burden.

units.zh: 百官嘗賜射，晞中的，當得絹，為不書箭，有司不與。
units.en: Once the hundred officials were granted an archery contest; Wang Xi hit the target and should have received silk, but because he did not mark his arrow, the office would not give it.
units.literal: Once the hundred officials were granted an archery contest; Xi hit the target and should have received silk, but because he did not mark his arrow, the office would not give it.

units.zh: 晞與清河崔瞻、頓丘李度、范陽盧正通首應此選。
units.en: Xi and Cui Zhan of Qinghe, Li Du of Dunqiu, and Lu Zhengtong of Fanyang were the first chosen for this.
units.literal: Xi and Cui Zhan of Qinghe, Li Du of Dunqiu, and Lu Zhengtong of Fanyang were the first chosen for this.

units.zh: 文襄時為大將軍，握晞等手曰：「我弟並向成長，志識未定，近善狎惡，不能不移。
units.en: Gao Cheng was then grand general; he took Xi and the others by the hand and said, "My younger brothers are all growing up; their aims and knowledge are not yet fixed—near goodness they draw close, near evil they inevitably shift.
units.literal: Gao Cheng was then grand general; he took Xi and the others by the hand and said: "My younger brothers are all growing up; their aims and knowledge are not yet fixed—near goodness they draw close, near evil they cannot but shift.

units.zh: 及文宣昏逸，常山王數諫，帝疑王假辭於晞，欲加大辟。
units.en: When Gao Yang grew dissolute, Prince of Changshan remonstrated repeatedly; Gao Yang suspected the prince borrowed his words from Xi and wished to impose the death penalty.
units.literal: When Gao Yang grew dissolute, Prince of Changshan remonstrated repeatedly; the emperor suspected the prince borrowed his words from Xi and wished to impose the death penalty.

units.zh: 王私謂晞曰：「博士，明日當作一條事，為欲相活，亦圖自全，宜深體勿怪。」
units.en: The prince said privately to Xi, "Doctor, tomorrow you must do one thing—for I mean to keep you alive and also to save myself; understand deeply and do not take it amiss."
units.literal: The prince said privately to Xi: "Doctor, tomorrow you must do one thing—for I mean to keep you alive and also to save myself; understand deeply and do not take it amiss."

units.zh: 乃於衆中杖晞二十。
units.en: He then had Xi beaten twenty strokes before the assembly.
units.literal: He then had Xi beaten twenty strokes before the assembly.

units.zh: 於是每問王疾，謂曰：「努力強食，當以王晞還汝。」
units.en: He then each day inquired after the prince's illness and told him, "Strive and force yourself to eat; I will give Wang Xi back to you."
units.literal: He then each day inquired after the prince's illness and told him: "Strive and force yourself to eat; I will give Wang Xi back to you."

units.zh: 王抱晞曰：「吾氣力綴然，恐不復相見。」
units.en: The prince embraced Xi and said, "My breath and strength are failing; I fear we shall not meet again."
units.literal: The prince embraced Xi and said: "My breath and strength are failing; I fear we shall not meet again."

units.zh: 常從容謂晞曰：「主上起居不恒，卿耳目所具，吾豈可以前逢一怒，遂爾結舌。
units.en: He often said calmly to Wang Xi, "The sovereign's conduct is unsteady; you see and hear what he does — can I really stay silent forever because I once provoked his anger?
units.literal: He often said calmly to Xi: "The sovereign's conduct is unsteady; you see and hear what he does — can I really stay silent forever because I once provoked his anger?

units.zh: 明日見晞曰：「吾長夜九思，今便息意。」
units.en: Next day he saw Wang Xi and said, "I thought all night; now my mind is at rest."
units.literal: Next day he saw Xi and said: "I thought all night; now my mind is at rest."

units.zh: 便命火對晞焚之。
units.en: He ordered fire and burned the draft before Wang Xi.
units.literal: He ordered fire and burned the draft before Xi.

units.zh: 王謂晞曰：「一人垂拱，吾曹亦保優閑。」
units.en: The prince said to Wang Xi, "One man holds court at ease; we too shall keep our ease."
units.literal: The prince said to Xi: "One man holds court at ease; we too shall keep our ease."

units.zh: 晞曰：「殿下今日地望，欲避周公得耶？」
units.en: Wang Xi said, "Your Highness's standing today — can you avoid the Duke of Zhou?"
units.literal: Xi said: "Your Highness's standing today — can you avoid the Duke of Zhou?"

units.zh: 乃延晞謂曰：「不早用卿言，使群小弄權，幾至傾覆。
units.en: He then summoned Wang Xi and said, "Because I did not heed your words early, petty men wielded power and I nearly came to ruin.
units.literal: He then summoned Xi and said: "Because I did not heed your words early, petty men wielded power and I nearly came to ruin.

units.zh: 後進晞密室曰：「比王侯諸貴每見煎迫，言我違天不祥，恐當或有變起，吾正欲以法繩之。」
units.en: Later the prince entered a private room and said, "Of late the princes and great men each press me, saying I go against heaven and invite ill fortune — fearing some change may rise. I mean to hold them by law."
units.literal: Later the prince entered a private room and said: "Of late the princes and great men each press me, saying I go against heaven and invite ill fortune — fearing some change may rise. I mean to hold them by law."

units.zh: 晞曰：「竊謂天時人事，同無異揆，是以冒犯雷霆，不憚斧鉞。
units.en: Wang Xi said, "I hold that heaven's timing and human affairs share one measure; therefore I offend the thunder, fearless of axe and halberd.
units.literal: Xi said: "I hold that heaven's timing and human affairs share one measure; therefore I offend the thunder, fearless of axe and halberd.

units.zh: 丞相從事中郎陸杳將出使，臨別握晞手曰：「相王功格區宇，天下樂推，歌謠滿道，物無異望。
units.en: Chancellor attendant Lu Yao was about to go on mission; on parting he clasped Wang Xi's hand and said, "The great prince's merit fills the realm, the realm joyfully urges him on, songs fill the roads, things have no different wish.
units.literal: Chancellor attendant Lu Yao was about to go on mission; on parting he clasped Xi's hand and said: "The great prince's merit fills the realm, the realm joyfully urges him on, songs fill the roads, things have no different wish.

units.zh: 晞尋述杳言。
units.en: Wang Xi soon repeated Yao's words.
units.literal: Xi soon repeated Yao's words.

units.zh: 晞以事隙問彥深，彥深曰：「我比亦驚此音謠，每欲陳聞，則口噤心戰。
units.en: Wang Xi seized a moment and asked Yanshen; Yanshen said, "I too of late was startled by these songs; each time I wished to report, my mouth locked and my heart trembled.
units.literal: Xi seized a moment and asked Yanshen; Yanshen said: "I too of late was startled by these songs; each time I wished to report, my mouth locked and my heart trembled.

units.zh: 每令晞就東堂監視太子冠服，導引趨拜。
units.en: Each time Wang Xi was sent to the eastern hall to oversee the crown prince's cap and robe, guiding and leading his pace in bowing.
units.literal: Each time Xi was sent to the eastern hall to oversee the crown prince's cap and robe, guiding and leading his pace in bowing.

units.zh: 帝曰：「庫莫奚南侵，我未經親戎，因此聊欲習武。」
units.en: The emperor said, "The Kumo Xi raid south; I have not myself led arms — therefore I wish for the moment to drill soldiers."
units.literal: The emperor said: "The Kumo Xi raid south; I have not myself led arms — therefore I wish for the moment to drill soldiers."

units.zh: 晞曰：「鑾駕巡狩，為復可爾，若輕有驅使，恐天下失望。」
units.en: Wang Xi said, "Imperial tours for inspection may still pass; if lightly there is dispatch, I fear the realm will lose hope."
units.literal: Xi said: "Imperial tours for inspection may still pass; if lightly there is dispatch, I fear the realm will lose hope."

units.zh: 時二人奏車駕北征後，人言陽休之、王晞數與諸人遊宴，不以公事在懷。
units.en: At that time the two reported that after the imperial carriage's northern campaign, people said Yang Xiuzhi and Wang Xi often feasted and wandered with others, not keeping public business in mind.
units.literal: At that time the two reported that after the imperial carriage's northern campaign, people said Yang Xiuzhi and Wang Xi often feasted and wandered with others, not keeping public business in mind.

units.zh: 帝杖休之、晞脛各四十。
units.en: The emperor flogged Xiuzhi and Wang Xi each forty blows on the shins.
units.literal: The emperor flogged Xiuzhi and Xi each forty blows on the shins.

units.zh: 帝斬人於前，問晞曰：「此人合死不？」
units.en: The emperor beheaded a man before him and asked Wang Xi, "Does this man deserve death?"
units.literal: The emperor beheaded a man before him and asked Xi: "Does this man deserve death?"

units.zh: 晞令妻答，妻終不言，晞以手拊胸而退。
units.en: Wang Xi had his wife answer; the wife never spoke; Wang Xi patted his chest with his hand and withdrew.
units.literal: Xi had his wife answer; the wife never spoke; Xi patted his chest with his hand and withdrew.

units.zh: 忽有相王使至，召晞不時至。
units.en: Suddenly a messenger of the great prince arrived; he summoned Wang Xi, who did not come at once.
units.literal: Suddenly a messenger of the great prince arrived; he summoned Xi, who did not come at once.

units.zh: 明日丞相西閤祭酒盧思道謂晞曰：「昨被召已朱顏，得不以魚鳥致怪？」
units.en: Next day Lu Sidao, libationer of the chancellor's Western Pavilion, said to Xi, "When you were summoned yesterday your face was already flushed — surely the fish and birds are not to blame for the offense?"
units.literal: The next day the chancellor's Western Pavilion Libationer Lu Sidao said to Xi, "Yesterday when you were summoned your face was already flushed — are the fish and birds not to blame for giving offense?"

units.zh: 山路險迥，懼有土賊，而晞溫酒服膏，曾不一廢。
units.en: The mountain road was treacherous and far; they feared bandits, yet Xi warmed his wine and took his salves without ever missing a day.
units.literal: The mountain road was dangerous and remote; they feared local bandits, yet Xi warmed his wine and applied salve without once discontinuing.

units.zh: 景乃擁衆於渦陽，與左衛將軍劉豐等相持。
units.en: Jing then massed troops at Woyang, locked in stalemate with left guard general Liu Feng and others.
units.literal: Jing then massed troops at Woyang, locked in stalemate with Left Guard General Liu Feng and others.

units.zh: 又拜使持節、河南總管、大都督，統慕容紹宗、劉豐等討王思政於長社。
units.en: He was also made bearer of the staff, grand governor of Henan, and grand commander, leading Murong Shaozong, Liu Feng, and others against Wang Sizheng at Changshe.
units.literal: He was also made Bearer of the Staff, Grand Governor of Henan, and Grand Commander, commanding Murong Shaozong, Liu Feng, and others to attack Wang Sizheng at Changshe.

units.zh: 紹宗、劉豐為思政所獲，關西出兵援思政，岳內外防禦，甚有謀算。
units.en: Shaozong and Liu Feng were captured by Sizheng; troops from west of the Pass came to aid him; Yue defended within and without with shrewd calculation.
units.literal: Shaozong and Liu Feng were captured by Sizheng; troops from west of the Pass came to aid Sizheng; Yue defended within and without with shrewd calculation.

units.zh: 五月壬子，以開府儀同三司劉洪徽爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the renzi day, Liu Honghui, holder of the honorific opener of the government with ritual parity of the three excellencies, was appointed right vice-director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the renzi day, Liu Honghui, opener of the government with ritual parity of the three excellencies, was made right vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 十一月乙卯，以右丞相、咸陽王斛律金爲左丞相，以錄尚書事、常山王演爲太傅，以司徒、長廣王湛爲太尉，以司空段韶爲司徒，以平陽王淹爲司空，高陽王湜爲尚書左僕射，河間王孝琬爲司州牧，侍中燕子獻爲右僕射。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, Hulu Jin, Prince of Xianyang and right chief minister, was appointed left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the Masters of Writing, became grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, became grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, became minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang became minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang became left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian became governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, palace attendant, became right vice-director.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, the right chief minister, Prince of Xianyang Hulu Jin, was made left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, was made grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, was made grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang was made minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was made governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, attendant at the palace, was made right vice-director.

units.zh: 弟昭，以功名自達，其餘親屬，未嘗為請爵位。
units.en: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.
units.literal: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.
